novel_features.name: Portfolio Summary with Per-Stock P&L
novel_features.description: See your total invested value, current value, overall P&L, and day change across all US stock holdings.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates portfolio data from INDmoney's private API into a clean terminal table or JSON for agents.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Get instant portfolio overview without opening the INDmoney app.

novel_features.name: Holdings Detail
novel_features.description: List every stock you hold with quantity, avg price, current value, unrealised gains, and day P&L.
novel_features.rationale: Per-stock breakdown with both metadata (sector, analyst rating) and holdings data in one query.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Filter and sort holdings by any field without the INDmoney UI's fixed views.

novel_features.name: Full Order History
novel_features.description: Every buy and sell order you have placed, with transaction type, quantity, avg price, and status.
novel_features.rationale: Complete trade history from INDmoney's order API, filterable and exportable.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Export your full trade history for tax reporting or analysis in one command.

novel_features.name: Sync to Local SQLite
novel_features.description: Download all portfolio data and order history into a local SQLite database for offline analysis.
novel_features.rationale: Local store enables SQL queries, historical tracking, and offline access to your portfolio data.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Build a local historical record of your portfolio snapshots and query it with SQL.

novel_features.name: Market Indices Snapshot
novel_features.description: Live prices for Nasdaq, S&P 500, Dow Jones, and other US indices with market status.
novel_features.rationale: Contextualize your portfolio performance against the broader market.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Quick market context before making trading decisions.

narrative.headline: Scrape your INDmoney US stock portfolio, holdings, and full trade history from the terminal.
narrative.value_prop: Pull your complete portfolio summary, per-stock P&L, and every buy/sell order from INDmoney's private API. Sync to local SQLite for offline analysis, SQL queries, and historical tracking — no spreadsheet exports needed.
narrative.auth_narrative: INDmoney authenticates via a JWT stored in the 'token' browser cookie. Extract the token cookie value from your logged-in browser session (DevTools > Application > Cookies > token), then run `auth set-token <token>` or set the INDMONEY_TOKEN env var. The token expires every ~9 hours; extract and set a fresh one to refresh.

quickstart.comment: Verify the CLI is ready before authenticating
Set your INDmoney token (extract from browser cookies)
See your total portfolio value and P&L
Export your full trade history as JSON
Save everything to local SQLite for offline analysis

troubleshoots.fix: The platform header is missing or token is malformed. Re-extract the token cookie and run auth set-token again.

troubleshoots.symptom: HTTP 512: Auth returned with status false
troubleshoots.fix: Your token expired (9h lifetime). Extract a fresh token cookie from the browser and run auth set-token again.
Token not set. Run auth set-token <token> or set INDMONEY_TOKEN env var with the token cookie value.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when you want to check your INDmoney US stock portfolio, export your trade history, or sync portfolio data locally for analysis. Ideal for tax reporting, performance tracking, and building a local historical record.
anti_triggers: Placing new buy/sell orders (use the INDmoney app)
Indian stock or mutual fund portfolios (this CLI covers US stocks only)
Real-time price alerts (use the INDmoney app's notification system)
